newsitem.title: EGYPT: Israeli, PLO negotiators meet in Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Israeli, PLO negotiators meet in Cairo.

text.p: Israeli and Palestinian negotiators met on Sunday for the first time in more than two months after untangling a last-minute snag over Jewish settlements.
Israeli and Palestinian negotiators did not speak to reporters as they entered Ittihadia presidential palace.

Their meeting in Cairo had been cast into doubt when Palestinian President Yasser Arafat's spokesman Marwan Kanafani told Reuters that Israel had in principle accepted a "pause" in settlement activities.
Israel reacted by saying it would refuse to take part in the planned peace talks until the PLO retracted the statement.
In Cairo, senior Palestinian negotiator Saeb Erekat then cleared the way for the meeting by saying Israel had not agreed to preconditions on settlement building.
"There is no agreement with the Israeli side," Erekat told reporters. He said he was not optimistic about the meeting because the two sides still had many disagreements.
